seed_convention: reset key = jax.random.PRNGKey(seed); raw key at step i = jax.random.fold_in(reset_key, i+1); prospective only.

scripts.scope: Prospective finite replay of actual reset/raw_step states
scripts.intended_objective: Attempt a supported first span, a real adjacent porter-to-builder handoff, a second span and all-crew far-bank occupancy. This is not an executed solution.
scripts.legality_claim: All integers are declared command attempts for active roles. Stop at joint completion and replace no remaining actions; dynamic legality and outcomes have not been executed or certified.

paired_intervention_hypotheses.scope: Paired raw trajectories from the identical reset key and literal shared prefix; replay both suffixes without policy learning.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.intended_difference: Only stabilizer action 7 replaces wait in A. With the same one-part porter at the western approach, intended capacity two permits its east move in A while unbraced capacity one blocks it in B.
zero_or_negative_outcomes: Both branches can have identical short-horizon rewards and no arrivals.
If the prefix did not leave the porter carrying exactly one part or the bridge installed, the intended contrast may be zero or invalid.
An expired or overloaded span can cause a negative or mixed outcome instead of the intended crossing.
Successful capacity mediation does not prove a better learned policy or higher eventual return.
paired_intervention_hypotheses.comparison_rule: Record actual state/observation/action identities and both trajectories. Report intended effects as absent, negative, mixed, failed or indeterminate if that is what execution shows; do not replace the action script after observing a result.
